name: Massages
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sanctity and divine purpose of the human body, urging believers to present their bodies as living sacrifices to God, holy and acceptable (Romans 12:1). While physical healing is acknowledged through the laying on of hands (Mark 16:18), ultimate peace and restoration come from Christ alone, who governs a kingdom not of this world (John 18:36) and grants a peace unlike that given by the world (John 14:27). This perspective calls Christians to rely on God's sovereign power and peace rather than solely on physical remedies such as massages.
